changelog:
Initial release: full interactive troubleshooting assistant for Huawei Cloud RDS (MySQL & PostgreSQL).

- Provides guided, step-by-step troubleshooting for common RDS production issues like slow queries, disk full, replication failures, and connectivity problems.
- Covers basic Q&A, SQL performance optimization (slow-log analysis), daily operations/status inspection, parameter tuning, and backup/restore guidance.
- Uses hcloud CLI (KooCLI) as primary execution mode, falling back to Python SDK/REST API if needed.
- All mutating operations require explicit user confirmation before execution.
- Output is interactive, showing one diagnostic step at a time, never dumping raw JSON.
summary: Full-scenario intelligent assistant for Huawei Cloud RDS (Relational Database Service, MySQL + PostgreSQL). Provides basic RDS Q&A, SQL performance optimization (slow-log analysis), daily instance operations, online fault location and troubleshooting, parameter tuning, and backup/restore guidance. Core scenario is ONLINE FAULT TROUBLESHOOTING: the skill guides the user step by step through symptoms (unreachable instance, slow queries, disk full, replication broken, connection limit exceeded, memory overrun) to diagnosis and resolution. Execution is CLI-first via `hcloud RDS ... --cli-region={region}` (KooCLI), falling back to the huaweicloudsdkrds Python SDK and then REST API. Output is interactive and guided — one diagnostic step at a time, with user confirmation before any mutating action (restart, parameter change, manual backup, restore). Triggers include: "RDS troubleshooting", "RDS故障排查", "数据库连不上", "RDS slow query", "RDS慢SQL", "RDS磁盘满", "RDS instance down", "RDS主备不同步", "RDS参数调优", "RDS备份恢复", "RDS error log", "RDS storage full", "troubleshoot RDS", "RDS诊断", "数据库性能优化", "RDS连接数满", "MySQL/PostgreSQL fault".
